title: Contracting Transport Maps on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We use inverse mean curvature flow to construct bi-Lipschitz maps that preserve normalized volume and decrease distances. These maps send a round sphere onto any smooth closed strictly convex hypersurface in a sphere and a flat disk onto any smooth strictly convex free-boundary disk in a Euclidean ball. In dimension two, this proves a conjecture of E. Milman for every smooth two-sphere with Gaussian curvature at least one and gives an analogous result for nonnegatively curved disks whose boundary has geodesic curvature one.
